AN 7.62x39 Conversion.info: Changes the ammotype fired to 7.62x39mm. Based on the prototyping / dummy model of the AN94 that theoretically fired 7.62x39mm. Expect AK-like traits such more power and recoil.

AWM .308 Conversion.info: Changes the ammunition fired from your AWM into .308 Winchester effectively changing it into the AWP! A much lighter but still deadly ammo type still capable of an one shot limb kill but much shorter. Improves handling, recoil, firing speed and doubles your ammo capacity! Perfect to counter terrorism!

SA80 .22 LR.info: Somehow, a great evil has returned. An esoteric conversion for the SA80 weapons. It trades away damage in exchange for much more manageable recoil and extra handling speed. Aim for headshots and it will be like you have unlimited power.

FT300 7.5.info:
Load your FT300 with the 7.5x55mm Swiss cartridge.
A heavier cartridge doing greater damage across range to an enemies torso, but travels slower with a slower reload. Higher penetration.

Timberwolf .408.info:
A .408 Chey Tac conversion kit for the Timberwolf rifle.
Possesses much higher damage and penetrative power, but comes at the cost of being more cumbersome to use.

MUZI 45 ACP.info: Convert your Micro Uzi into the civilian variant that fires .45 ACP in semi auto with stats to match the change.

S-12U 762 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with 7.62x39mm
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

AUG .22 LR Conversion.info:
Convert your UAR HEAVY into .22 Long Rifle.
I heard you wanted even less recoil. So this Nomensland variant of the UAR made specially for training helps give you that true 'No Recoil' feel! But the damage to fit the caliber.

ECR 410.info: Convert your ECR to fire .410 bore, housing a 15 round magazine and strong firepower. Doesn't do well at range and struggles with maneuverability.

SVDS 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SVDS with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

NTW 20 Conversion.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 20x110mm Hispano-Suiza.

Improves muzzle velocity and damage per shot, but reduces overall penetration.

AKU 9mm Conversion.info:
A speculative 9x19mm kit for the AK-12 platform, likely intended for the export market to law enforcement.

Low damage, low recoil, excellent handling.

SKORP Rat Shot.info: Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Ratshot. Make those shots count; with a small magazine size, Ratshot is very effective at close range but is extremely ineffective at longer ranges.

MP5K 10mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your SMX-9K into 10mm Auto, effectively making it the ''SMX-9/10''.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired, can you handle the bull?.

X95R .300 Conversion.info:
Convert your X95R to fire .300 AAC Blackout.
Adjusts performance of the firearm.

7.5x55mm Swiss (WA2K).info: A cartridge introduced in 1898, originating from the 7.5x53.5mm cartridge. Allows the WA2000 to perform better at range, penetration and fire rate at the cost of velocity and a shortened torso kill!

AK12 9x39 Conversion.info:
Converts your AK-9 to fire the more traditional 7.62x39mm cartridge, turning it into the AK-12 7.62mm prototype carbine.
Increases muzzle velocity and magazine capacity, while overall reducing damage and penetration slightly.

FT300 6XC.info:
Load your FT300 with the 6XC wildcat cartridge.
Offering poorer close range performance to the .243 winchester cartridge, but it is preferred for long range usage with its slightly improved velocity and ranges due to weight and a faster reload and action time. Small increase to penetration.

VSS 762 Conv.info:
Changes the ammotype fired from your VSS VINTOREZ to 7.62x39mm.
This retools your weapon to be a lot like the civilian model produced by Molot Arms, that suppressor is not doing anything, bucko.

Uzi .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .45 ACP.
Improve damage performance but makes the recoil harder to control. Lowered RPM.
Conversion kit by Vector Arms allows the UZI to use M3A1 magazines!

NTW 14.5 Conversion.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 14.5x114mm.
 This turns the weapon into the  NTW-14.5, Keeping the 3 round magazine and giving more optimal sniper rifle performance.

G36K .300 Conversion.info:
Load your STG-91K with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group, offering poorer close range close range, but greater long range performance. Great with suppressors!

VPO .366 (Buckshot).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM (Buckshot).
By Zarovian law this makes your gun a shotgun because of the smoothbore barrel.

Obrez 8mm Conversion.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that makes your Obrez Pistol fire the larger 8x50mmR cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a certain range. It does not perform as well at range, among other faults of the cartridge...

GB 10mm Conversion.info:
Load your GB-22 with 10mm Auto.
 This makes it a GB-10, the larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried. Great velocity.
